audit.whatIsWrong: The entry calls Fling his W throughout — 'W-fling', 'his W fling', 'Land his W fling' — and calls Poison Trail 'W trail'. Mega Adhesive, the actual W, is never mentioned once.
audit.why: Fling is E and Mega Adhesive is W, and the distinction is the whole matchup. Riot's text: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' The flip on its own is survivable; the flip into pre-laid goo is a root on top of Poison Trail. A Mel reading this entry watches the wrong ability and never learns that the goo comes first.
audit.corrected: Name Mega Adhesive (W, 1000 range, grounds and slows), Fling (E, 125 range), Poison Trail (Q, toggle) — and state that Fling only roots when it lands you in the goo.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it directly: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in the entry.
audit.why: Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s at 125 range; Mega Adhesive is 17/16/15/14/13s at 1000 range; Solar Snare is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s. Two concrete sequences fall out. First, Solar Snare and Fling are nearly the same cooldown, so Mel cannot expect to root every step-up — she gets one for one. Second, Mega Adhesive is by far his longest cooldown and it is the one that upgrades Fling into a root, so the seventeen seconds after the goo is thrown are the safe window to step inside 125.
audit.corrected: Add both: snare 11s versus Fling 10s, and step in during the 17s after Mega Adhesive is spent.

audit.why: The proxy-denial plan is the right wave read against Singed and is already stated in both mid and late. Nothing to change.

edits.after: With Q + Solar Snare you can root him the instant he steps inside Fling's 125 range, then walk out and Q-poke the rooted target free.

edits.after: His danger window: full Rylai's/Riftmaker drain-tank Singed eats your poke, perma-slows you with Poison Trail, and runs you down past one Solar Snare.

edits.after: Hold Solar Snare for the step inside Fling's 125 range, root him, then Q-poke and back off before Poison Trail builds

edits.before: Land his W fling to flip you into his poison trail and toward his tower, ignoring your Solar Snare on its long cooldown
edits.after: Throw Mega Adhesive first, then Fling you into it — landing in that goo roots you on top of the Poison Trail

edits.before: Build move speed and Rylai's slow so your one root is irrelevant and he runs you down all game
edits.after: Build move speed and Rylai's so his 17s Mega Adhesive outlasts your 11s snare all game

edits.before: Singed only has his W fling at level 1 and it can't reach past your 550 Q — poke him as he steps to the wave.
edits.after: Fling reaches 125 and Poison Trail is a toggle he pays mana for — poke him as he steps to the wave.

edits.after: Solar Snare is 11s to Fling's 10s — root him as he commits and free-poke the rooted target.

edits.before: Singed only has his fling and poison trail early, and neither out-ranges your 550 Q — so this is your window to bully. Hold Solar Snare for the exact moment he walks in to W-fling you: root him, Q the stationary target, then step out before the poison trail tics you down. Do NOT dry-Q the wave while he's at fling range, because his only kill pattern is flipping you into the trail and toward his tower. Keep stacking Overwhelm off Q and empowered autos and he can't sustain through it yet.
edits.after: Singed only has Fling and Poison Trail early, and neither out-ranges your 550 Q — so this is your window to bully. Hold Solar Snare for the exact moment he walks inside Fling's 125 range: root him, Q the stationary target, then step out before the trail tics you down. Do NOT dry-Q the wave while he is that close, because his kill pattern is flipping you into the trail and toward his tower. Keep stacking Overwhelm off Q and empowered autos while he still can't sustain it.

edits.before: This is your takeover. With Q ranked and Solar Snare's root + slow field, you control every step-up — he can't reach you without eating a poke he can't yet drain back. At 6, Golden Eclipse detonates your built-up Overwhelm from any range, so even as he flings and tries to kite away on his move speed, you chunk or execute him before he resets. Your W barrier eats nothing from him since he has no projectile, so just use it for the shield and move speed to disengage his trail. Force fights on his proxy waves and deny the farm his scaling needs.
edits.after: This is your takeover. With Q ranked and Solar Snare's root plus slow field, you control every step-up — he can't reach you without eating a poke he can't yet drain back. At 6, Golden Eclipse detonates your built-up Overwhelm from any range, so even as he flings and kites away on his move speed, you chunk or execute him first. Read the ground before you read his cooldowns: once Mega Adhesive is thrown you have 17 seconds at rank 1 where a Fling has no goo to root you in. Force fights on his proxy waves.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — The flip into his goo — never chase into range while it is up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rebuttal has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Singed Fling: 10s at rank 1 and only 125 range, but Mega Adhesive at 17s is the spell that turns the flip into a root — read the ground. - Your W Rebuttal has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R: the moment it goes right.

edits.before: Stack Overwhelm with every hit — once he's marked deep, your execute math starts working. Track Fling before stepping up.
edits.after: Stack Overwhelm with every hit — Fling is 10s at 125 range, so your snare only has to beat his walk-up, not his reach.

edits.before: Track Singed’s Fling: The flip into his goo — never chase into range while it is up. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Singed’s Mega Adhesive ahead of Fling: landing in that goo is what turns the 125-range flip into a root.

edits.before: The flip into his goo — never chase into range while it is up. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: The flip only roots if the goo is already down — 17s at rank 1, so watch the ground, not just Fling.

edits.before: Singed burns Fling on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Singed burns Fling on nothing — that is a ten-second invitation.

notes: The packet's suspectName 'Solar Snare's' is a false positive — Mel's real E name with a possessive. The removed clause 'Your W barrier eats nothing from him since he has no projectile' was both a non-interaction and inaccurate: Mega Adhesive is a thrown vial and is flagged as a projectile in the kit. Whether Rebuttal can actually reflect a ground-targeted throw is not answerable from the kit files, so I made no claim either way — that one is worth a Wiki check before anyone writes it up.
